item.description: The man accused of planning the murder of Tupac Shakur is set to stand trial as prosecutors look to prove Duane "Keefe D" Davis orchestrated the drive-by shooting that killed the hip-hop legend nearly 30 years ago. Davis has spent years talking about his involvement in the case, saying he was inside the Cadillac with the gunman when shots were fired from the backseat near the Las Vegas strip. NBC’s Chloe Melas reports and senior legal correspondent Laura Jarrett joins TODAY with analysis.

item.description: New York City police are on the scene of a tragic boating accident where a woman and a young child were killed near the Statue of Liberty. WNBC’s Jessica Cunnington reports for Sunday TODAY.
